# Sur / window_sweep / results

**Owner:** Sur. This folder holds the result bundle of the last full sweep, written by `../run_sweep.py`. Do not edit these files by hand; re-run instead.

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `runs.csv` | one row per run: settings and metrics |
| `summary.csv` | mean and 95 % bootstrap CI over seeds, per policy setting × scenario |
| `curves.csv.gz` | mean smoothed goodput G(t), per policy setting × scenario |
| `manifest.json` | git commit, config hashes, versions, command |
| `tables.md` | every table of `../RESULTS.md`, generated by `../make_tables.py` |
| `figures/` | every figure, generated by `../make_figures.py` |
| `raw/` | full decision logs, only with `--save-logs` (not in git) |
